test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is INCORRECT regarding the flow of energy between various components of the environment?

options.text: The amount of organic matter present at each trophic level is 10%.
Green plants capture about 10% of the solar energy that falls on leaves.
Every trophic level loses some energy as heat to the environment.

solution:
The correct answer is **__Green plants capture about 10% of the solar energy that falls on leaves__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f3
6cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Plants absorb **only 1-2% **of the **sunlight **that falls on leaves, as **98-99 % of the sunlight **is **reflected back** and converted to heat.
 
• Energy flow is **unidirectional** from the lower trophic level to the higher trophic level. 
 
• **10%** of energy is absorbed by each trophic level and the rest is lost in the environment.
